reviews.x: Item came dirty ,other then that works well nice long usb cable cute n compact i love pink

this was clearly a used product as the blue film was already removed (you could see bits of it in the edges) there's scratches and it was a little dirty. I cleaned it and it does cure gel but I'm annoyed they couldn't just send me a new product or at least clean it up before they repackaged it.
I love that it has 36w which makes it nice and strong for what I need it for. (resin jewelry) It works fantastic and its easy to use, and small in size.  What more do you want?

Cures well but you have to click the button every 50 seconds or so. I'm using it for polymer clay jewelry and each piece I have to click 10x or more. The small size doesn't bother me but the short duration of the light session is bothersome. It was inexpensive at $8.99 and not using resin previously, a cheap way to find out if it was something I wished to continue. Wish I had just gone ahead and opted for a better quality lamp. I will keep it as a backup.
I bought this to use with a clear gel base and top coat over some nail wraps. It works fine, as expected. I do two sessions each time so I can’t comment on if one would do the trick.

reviews.t: Worked for me, cheapest found but does work :)
reviews.x: It does the job, it does take a couple extra clicks to finish the curing but it's great for the price. Recommend it for beginners!

reviews.t: easy to use and carry out
reviews.x: it's very small and thin, so it's very easy to carry out. I like the pink color, but I have to push two times to make the nail polish dry. so I give 4 stars.
I absolutely loved this small UV LED Lamp! It is easy to use, it comes nicely packaged and it works pretty well!

I purchase this UV lamp on September 21st. reviews.t: Works great with Genuine Gel Polish!!
reviews.x: I am not a beginner, I actually own a double UV lamp and have been doing my own gel nails for over 8 or more years.. I needed a pocket size unit for traveling.  This works great and I have been traveling now for over 7 months doing my gelish nails on the road. I since have been back home and still find myself using this pocket size unit instead of by big UV lamp.

Wouldn’t even turn on. What a waste of money.  UPDATE== I was sent a new lamp and thank god ! I love it .This little nail  lamp perfect for travel which is exactly why I got it and affordable.I found myself reaching for this over my 80 watt lamp . It’s small, compact and easily stored . I’m truly impressed. I did not think this was going to work As well as it does .If you’re on the fence don’t be buy it you won’t regret it .

This was the first ever led/uv I’ve ever purchased so I didn’t know what to except and let me tell you it’s horrible but hey you get what you pay for it’s nice because it’s pink and small and portable it sucks cause it really is cute but you literally have to press the button to cure like 50 times just to get one layer of gel to cure ! Don’t waste your money just purchase a nicer one for 20 plus trust me !!!!

I chose this because I wanted a light that had a more universal power cord, which this one uses a micro usb which I have a ton of.  Then it also is small and folds up so I can just put it in my nail kit.  It works great for my nails as well.
I kind that this can be charged with a USB. It works great. Better if one hand at a time. Could use for feet, too. It's easy to use and dries everything within 5 minutes
feels a little cheap in the hand but its nice that it folds and it work perfectly fine. my first UV light for nail and id reccomend it.
I use this for curing UV resin. Works perfect.  It’s portable, light and easy to use.

My wife loves this UV nail lamp. Perfect size, excellent price. Does excatly what it was intended for. It's the mini one. Dries her nails in half the time(w/no dryer) leaves painted nails shimmery. Works perfect for using to cure Gel Nails. Price is "Outstanding" for the item with just a name brand stuck to it would go for over $100 this no name light works just as well as those "High End" UV-lights Would highly recommend, if your looking for quality at a fair price.

I do my nails every week it's easy to carry dries nails so fast long-lasting it can go for a month..this is my bestfriend cannot be smaller than this I guess u guys did it this time. And so genius u can use with your phone charger who doesn't have one see very thoughtful great invention..now make one for single finger with on and off. Because ur product rocks. Thanks so much all my space needs have been solved.

First, I actually bought this by accident, but I  recommemd you don't.  First, it's just naked bulbs shining light on your fingers, and after about 60-seconds it feels like they're getting hot and tingly. NEVER feels that way at the salon or my last lamp.  Then there's there's the fact that after 3-minutes my nails were still tacky, and that was still the first coat.

Product arrived on time as promised. However, the product is obviously used. Protective blue film is missing and there are large smudges all over the product. Could not add picture because it would not load. Once plugged up, it does light up, but I have not used it. Hope it works. Did not expect to pay full price for a used product. Will keep it as long as it works.

It works great. A little bulkier than my last light but not by much. The only problem is I got this in november 29th and its march 21st- (4 mo): The glue came apart inside the lamp where I connect the cable. Its still a good uv lamp (especially for my buying price) but this may be an opportunity to try another one to find my perfect light.

thus item is good for beginners just starting out. i wish it had a timer like some of the others instead of turning off after 60 seconds. it works great and is very easy to use. i like that it can connect to a usb and doesn’t have to be plugged into a wall outlet. it is okay for the price.

reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: Nice for beginners but in the grand scheme of things, just spend more money. I bought this and it takes forever to cure my small items (dog tags, puzzle piece, etc) I have to sit there and press the start button at least 20 times and even then there’s no guarantee the item is finished.

reviews.t: Product does not work for long before it’s broken
reviews.x: It’s easy to o use for beginners and great for traveling as it folds and is lightweight  but it wasn’t  a great value for money. Bought mine 2 months ago and  its stopped working now. No light nothing. And I’ve only used it like 4 times. Very disappointed.

DO NOT ORDER!!! I ordered this lamp on March 10,2021 and today is May 20, 2021 and the port that  connects to the lamp detached and I assume it's in the body of the lamp because when I shake it I hear something rattling. This is a piece of CRAP!!!!!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the lamp small, compact, and easy to carry or store, often praising its portability.
Several reviewers say it works well for curing gel nails, resin, or polymer clay, though some note needing multiple sessions or extra clicks to fully cure.
Some reviewers received dirty, scratched, or previously used units, which they found annoying.
A few reviewers report durability or quality problems, including a unit that stopped working after a few uses and one that wouldn't turn on (later replaced).
Reviewers frequently mention the pink color and low price as positives.
